payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP array where dp[i] is max score ending at problem i; iterates all pairs (j,i) with j<i, updates both dp[i] and dp[j] using max of current and opposite+score_diff.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a single array of size n, state defined by last solved problem index, typical for 1D DP. No 2D state or bitmask.
